description: Drafts the legal notice text a New York LLC publishes (§206), a foreign LLC's Notice of Qualification (§802), or a PLLC's notice (§1203), from the LLC's details. Anything not given prints as a bracketed placeholder. Uses the same wording the FileMyPublication site generates.

county.description: The New York county named in the LLC's Articles of Organization, e.g. 'Albany', 'Nassau', 'Brooklyn' or 'Kings'. Borough names are accepted.

foreign_formation_date.description: Foreign LLC only: date of organization, YYYY-MM-DD.

foreign_jurisdiction.description: Foreign LLC only: state or country of organization.

foreign_office_address.description: Foreign LLC only: office address in the home jurisdiction.

formation_date.description: Filing date of the Articles of Organization (foreign LLC: Application for Authority), YYYY-MM-DD.

llc_name.description: The LLC's exact name as filed with the Department of State.

purpose.description: Business purpose. Leave out for 'any lawful act'. For a PLLC, the profession.

registered_agent_name.description: Optional registered agent's name (with its address).

service_of_process_address.description: The address the Secretary of State mails legal papers to, from the filing receipt.

name: draft_publication_notice
title: Draft the publication notice
